technical_and_design_decisions: Utilize Spring MVC and Spring HATEOAS to build RESTful endpoints wrapping StreamController capabilities in Spring Cloud Data.
Extend Spring Shell to invoke the newly established StreamController REST APIs for remote stream management.
Refactor ModuleLauncher into a native Spring Boot component utilizing @ConfigurationProperties for configuration management and classpath augmentation.
Enhance Spring Boot ClassLoader mechanisms to resolve and dynamically inject external module JAR dependencies (such as database drivers) at runtime.
Adapt the legacy Spring XD Redis counter sink module into a Spring Cloud Stream sink using modern Spring Data Redis abstractions.
Configure CI build pipelines using standardized CI/CD configuration files (e.g., GitHub Actions / Travis CI) for both spring-cloud-data and spring-cloud-stream-modules repositories.
assumptions: Development and testing will be performed by a single software engineer handling the entire lifecycle.
The baseline repositories (spring-cloud-data, spring-cloud-stream, spring-cloud-stream-modules) are set up and building locally on JDK 17+.
CI server platform access and credentials are available and only require configuration file authoring and repository webhook enablement.
Investigation spike for HDFS/PHD (U6) requires technical assessment and a proof-of-concept design document rather than a full production implementation.

activities.activity_description: Analyze technical requirements across s-c-d and s-c-s modules, design classloader isolation strategies, REST contracts, and ModuleLauncher refactoring architecture.

activities.activity_name: REST API Implementation for Stream Operations (U7)
activities.activity_description: Implement REST controllers and DTOs in spring-cloud-data to expose StreamController methods for creating, deploying, undeploying, and querying streams.

activities.activity_name: Shell Command Integration with REST Endpoints (U1)
activities.activity_description: Add and update Spring Shell commands in spring-cloud-data CLI to execute stream validation and administration via StreamController REST APIs.
Migrate ModuleLauncher to a Spring Boot application framework, enabling externalized configuration properties, environment settings, and classpath expansion.

activities.activity_name: Module Dependency Resolution & Boot Loader Augmentation (U4)
activities.activity_description: Implement dependency resolution mechanisms to fetch and append external module JARs (e.g., JDBC drivers) into the Spring Boot classloader hierarchy at runtime.

activities.activity_name: Adapt Redis Counter Module from XD to s-c-s (U2)
activities.activity_description: Port the Spring XD Redis counter implementation into a spring-cloud-stream standalone module to support dashboard streaming pipelines.

activities.activity_name: Investigation Spike for PHD/HDFS Classpath Provider (U6)
activities.activity_description: Investigate and document the feasibility and approach for porting PHD as a provider for HDFS modules, addressing root classpath dependency requirements.
Author, test, and verify continuous integration build scripts for the spring-cloud-data repository to trigger automatic builds and test execution on commits.
Create and validate CI pipeline configurations for the spring-cloud-stream-modules repository to execute builds and unit/integration test suites continuously.
Perform comprehensive integration testing across shell, REST APIs, ModuleLauncher classloader extensions, and update relevant developer documentation.
